item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-a436ebcc3e3c5101","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The Constitutional Court confirmed Félix Tshisekedi's reelection in the 20 December 2023 presidential election with 73.47% of the vote after reviewing two challenges; one was found admissible but unfounded and the other inadmissible.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The election and adjudication occurred in 2023; the source was published on 9 January 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The presidency reports the Court's confirmation of Tshisekedi's reelection and the handling of electoral challenges.","limitations":["This is an official presidential source and does not independently verify the court's reasoning or the broader credibility of the election."]},{"source_id":"SRC-762318e761396097","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"At the May 2023 Bujumbura summit, Tshisekedi publicly accused Rwanda of supporting and enabling the M23's occupation and urged revitalization of the regional peace framework; the final communiqué condemned the occupation, reaffirmed sovereignty and borders, called for de-escalation, and supported the Luanda and Nairobi processes.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The summit and reported decisions occurred in May 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Tshisekedi chaired the regional follow-up mechanism and made the accusation and revitalization proposal; the summit participants adopted the communiqué.","limitations":["The source is the presidency's account and does not establish whether the measures produced durable de-escalation or compliance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a5c0720e1fe78094","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In a February 2023 address to the UN Human Rights Council, Tshisekedi called for international sanctions against perpetrators of crimes in the DRC and implementation of the Nairobi and Luanda peace plans, and stated that judicial reform, a possible special criminal court, victim compensation, and a reparations fund were priorities.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.9","3B.4","3B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The address and stated priorities were made in February 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The presidency attributes the proposals and commitments directly to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source records statements and proposed mechanisms, not their implementation or results during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0b310dfa7c9d873f","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In his 30 June 2023 independence address, Tshisekedi acknowledged declining purchasing power, especially among poorer people, and said that increased domestic revenue collection and digitalization had not been sufficiently felt because of global economic conditions and insecurity in the east.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.8","5B.9","6B.5","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The statement concerns conditions and policy performance in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Tshisekedi publicly acknowledged the welfare and revenue-collection outcomes and attributed constraints to external and security shocks.","limitations":["The account is a presidential speech and provides no independent measurement of the magnitude or causes of the purchasing-power decline."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0b310dfa7c9d873f","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Tshisekedi said the government had assigned the Prime Minister and Central Bank to intensify macroeconomic stabilization efforts, improve public governance in those sectors, and limit harm to household purchasing power; he cited IMF growth forecasts of 8% for 2023, 7.2% for 2024, and 7.5% for 2025.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The assignment and the 2023 forecast were stated in June 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Tshisekedi publicly assigned the tasks and cited the forecasts in his address.","limitations":["The source does not show execution, actual 2023 growth, or whether stabilization measures improved household welfare."]},{"source_id":"SRC-115329710b8d754a","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The 30 September 2023 Official Gazette listed presidential judicial orders dated 15 August 2023 that revoked or compulsorily retired multiple civilian and military judges and prosecutors and appointed or reassigned judicial personnel across the Court of Cassation, Council of State, appellate courts, trial courts, peace courts, and military courts.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.4","4B.5","7B.5","8B.4","8B.5"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The orders were issued in August 2023 and published in the 2023 Official Gazette.","ruler_attribution":"The gazette lists the measures as presidential judicial ordinances.","limitations":["The summary does not provide reasons for individual removals or appointments, qualifications of appointees, or evidence of subsequent judicial independence or performance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-47aa0e758552561c","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"In July 2023, Tshisekedi authorized repeated extensions of the state of siege in part of the DRC through Ordinance-Law 23/014 and Ordinance 23/118; a further authorization was listed on 30 July through Ordinance-Law 23/015.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.9","4B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The extensions were authorized in July 2023 and recorded in the August 2023 Official Gazette summary.","ruler_attribution":"The gazette identifies the measures as presidential ordinances and ordinance-laws.","limitations":["The summary does not describe the geographic scope beyond 'part of the territory,' the substantive safeguards, legislative process, or effects on abuses and security."]},{"source_id":"SRC-47aa0e758552561c","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"A May 2023 interministerial order modified and supplemented the system for banking land and real-estate transactions nationwide.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.4","5B.6","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The order was issued in May 2023 and listed in the August 2023 Official Gazette summary.","ruler_attribution":"The measure was issued by the finance and land-affairs ministries within the administration during Tshisekedi's presidency.","limitations":["The summary does not establish implementation, compliance, effects on investment, or whether the system reduced corruption."]},{"source_id":"SRC-355d91459fdad3e7","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The Official Gazette summary listed October 2023 ratification laws covering public debt, special economic zones, amendments to the penal and criminal-procedure codes, and a medal of valor for the homeland.","question_ids":["2B.4","3B.1","3B.5","5B.3","5B.4","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The ratifications were dated 12 October 2023 and published in the 2023 gazette summary.","ruler_attribution":"The laws were promulgated under the presidency and recorded under the Presidency of the Republic.","limitations":["The summary gives titles only and does not show the content, implementation, enforcement, or effects of the laws."]},{"source_id":"SRC-355d91459fdad3e7","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"A government decree dated 26 August 2023 specified procedures for collecting and distributing mining royalties.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The decree was issued in August 2023 and recorded in the November 2023 Official Gazette summary.","ruler_attribution":"The decree was issued by the Prime Minister's cabinet during Tshisekedi's presidency.","limitations":["The source does not report actual royalty collection, distribution, transparency, audit findings, or effects on communities."]},{"source_id":"SRC-355d91459fdad3e7","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"A September 2023 interministerial order established the state's share of proceeds from carbon-credit sales.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The order was issued in September 2023 and recorded in the November 2023 Official Gazette summary.","ruler_attribution":"The measure was issued by the environment and finance ministries during Tshisekedi's presidency.","limitations":["The summary does not show implementation, revenue amounts, distributional effects, or oversight."]},{"source_id":"SRC-355d91459fdad3e7","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"A July 2023 presidential ordinance appointed advisers to the President's cabinet.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.5"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The appointment was dated 28 July 2023 and recorded in the November 2023 Official Gazette summary.","ruler_attribution":"The gazette identifies the measure as a presidential ordinance appointing cabinet advisers.","limitations":["The source does not identify the advisers, their qualifications, responsibilities, or performance."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-cb6386e633789602","SRC-86f3e63e64e0c4ea","SRC-7fe105537e33fdfa","SRC-10b58720c1a8a214","SRC-5a86ab57e781ae82"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied materials contain substantial official statements and legal listings but limited independent evidence about implementation, outcomes, abuses, fiscal execution, or causal attribution during 2023.","SRC-cb6386e633789602 is primarily a 2019 biography; its material 2023 content is limited to the election update.","SRC-86f3e63e64e0c4ea and SRC-7fe105537e33fdfa are index or navigation pages without substantive 2023 findings about Tshisekedi.","SRC-10b58720c1a8a214 lists audit and report titles but does not provide the underlying findings.","SRC-5a86ab57e781ae82 reports Tshisekedi's participation in a January 2023 SADC meeting and describes DRC voting on Ukraine resolutions, but does not establish a distinct 2023 decision by Tshisekedi personally."]}
